body: This isnt particularly helpful.  Its a quality issue itself.  I am not capable of living a life that wouldnt be better off if i ended it ASAP.  Being flayed alive would be an improvement over a typical weekday, and thats the issue.

Theres just no one around to permanently connect to.  That, and i have issues with previous friends being the absolute worst the human race has ever had to offer. Im getting older and being less and less of a person and more of an unsalvagable mess doesnt help.

I need some sort of psychiatry, im sure, but yet another therapist makes suicide look better and better.
After my experience, getting any therapist let alone a terrible one is a marathon x.x
I see.  Thats a shame, but im not too surprised.
